"[[Hypixel SkyBlock OST#Safari Rainbug|Safari Rainbug]]" |mobs= * Cavernfish * Chuckwalla * Driftling * Gemzie * Rockmite * Scrappy * Shyworm * Snoozle * Flitter * Bluebird * Fluffling * Foxtrot * Hideonfloor * Honeybug * Macaw * Parakeet * Treefrog * Woodchucker * Areita * Bloodbat * Doomspiral * Duplico * Gazer * Gimmiegold * Hideonwall * Hideyho * Litterbug * Solsnatcher * Billygoat * Mantis Shrimp * Nozzlenose * Polaris * Shuddersquid * Strongarm * Tepid * Troodon * Wumpa |resources = * Bag of Seeds * Flavor-packed Fish * Icebreaker * Lime Gem * Lush Lily Pad * Shining Coin * Soothing Incense * Orange Gem * Purple Gem * Wholesale Wheat * Wriggleworm * Yogi Berry }} The '''Critter Safari''' is a [[Hunting]] [[Location]] accessible from the {{Zone|Torrhus Canyon}}. After reaching {{Skill|Hunting|XV}}, it can be accessed by speaking to the {{NPCSprite|Safari Manager}} using [[Safari Tickets]], which are obtained from {{NPCSprite|Miria}}'s [[Starlyn Contest]]s. == Accessing == The '''Critter Safari''' can be accessed from the {{NPCSprite|Safari Manager}} using [[File:Name Tag.png|21px|link=]] [[Safari Tickets]]. These come in multiple varieties, obtained from [[Miria's Contest]]s. * {{DarkGreen|'''Basic Safari Ticket'''}}: Unlocks the {{DarkGreen|Basic Safari Experience}}. The player starts with {{Item|Critter Capsule|amount=32}}s. * {{Blue|'''Economy Safari Ticket'''}}: Unlocks the {{Blue|Economy Safari Experience}}. The player starts with {{Item|Critter Capsule|amount=40}}s and gains {{Green|+10%}} {{Item|Safari Essence}} and {{Stat|Hunting Wisdom|+5}}. * {{Purple|'''Premium Safari Ticket'''}}: Unlocks the {{Purple|Premium Safari Experience}}. The player starts with {{Item|Critter Capsule|amount=48}}s and gains {{Green|+25%}} {{Item|Safari Essence}} and {{Stat|Hunting Wisdom|+15}}. * {{Gold|'''First-Class Safari Ticket'''}}: Unlocks the {{Gold|First-Class Safari Experience}}. The player starts with {{Item|Critter Capsule|amount=56}}s, gains {{Green|+50%}} {{Item|Safari Essence}}, {{Stat|Hunting Wisdom|+25}}, and gains a random Quest Item upon entering the '''Critter Safari'''. Higher tiers of [[Safari Tickets]] are obtained from reaching higher brackets in [[Miria's Contest]]. When the player runs out of {{Item|Critter Capsule}}s, they are given the option to leave the '''Critter Safari'''. == Biomes == The '''Critter Safari''' is split into {{Green|4}} biomes: the {{Gold|Cavern}}, {{DarkGreen|Forest}}, {{Purple|Haunted}}, and {{Blue|Icy}} biomes. Each biome has their own sets of [[Critters]], [[#Floor Drops|Floor Drops]], and mechanics. [[Floor Drops]] can be found on the ground, marked by {{Item|String|link=}}. They will grant either {{Item|Safari Essence}}, {{Skill|Hunting|XP}}, a shard, or a random '''Quest Item''', which can be used throughout the '''Critter Safari''' to interact with the map. === Cavern === The {{Gold|Cavern}} biome consists of a large cavern system that stretches into the bowels of the map, with large veins of {{ID|Block of Raw Gold!Raw Gold|nolink=yes}}, carts full of ores, and mining platforms. The following [[Critters]] can be hunted here: {{MobSprite|Cavernfish}}, {{MobSprite|Flitter}}, {{MobSprite|Shyworm}}, {{MobSprite|Driftling}}, {{MobSprite|Chuckwalla}}, {{MobSprite|Rockmite}}, {{MobSprite|Scrappy}}, {{MobSprite|Snoozle}}, and {{MobSprite|Gemzie}}. === Forest === The {{Dark Green|Forest}} biome consists of a sprawling network of trees and a small underground cave system. The following [[Critters]] can be hunted here: {{MobSprite|Foxtrot}}, {{MobSprite|Bluebird}}, {{MobSprite|Honeybug}}, {{MobSprite|Treefrog}}, {{MobSprite|Woodchucker}}, {{MobSprite|Fluffling}}, {{MobSprite|Hideonfloor}}, {{MobSprite|Parakeet}}, and {{MobSprite|Macaw}}. The {{Dark Green|Forest}} also contains the '''Birdfeeder''', which allows players to summon the {{MobSprite|Bluebird}}, {{MobSprite|Parakeet}}, or {{MobSprite|Macaw}} using foods found from [[#Floor Drops|Floor Drops]] found throughout the {{Dark Green|Forest}} biome. Different foods buff different bird chances. The '''Birdfeeder''' can be found at {{Coordinates|-1|90|44}}. === Haunted === The {{Purple|Haunted}} biome consists of a large haunted mansion and a small underground cave to spawn the {{MobSprite|Doomspiral}}. The following [[Critters]] can be hunted here: {{MobSprite|Areita}}, {{MobSprite|Bloodbat}}, {{MobSprite|Duplico}}, {{MobSprite|Gazer}}, {{MobSprite|Litterbug}}, {{MobSprite|Solsnatcher}}, {{MobSprite|Gimmiegold}}, {{MobSprite|Hideonwall}}, {{MobSprite|Hideyho}}, and {{MobSprite|Doomspiral}}. === Icy === The {{Blue|Icy}} biome features the same {{Stat|cold}} mechanic from the {{Zone|Glacite Tunnels}}. This can be decreased while near campfires. {{Stat|cr}} applies in the {{Blue|Icy}} biome, and being in water will cause {{Stat|cold}} to increment faster. The following [[Critters]] can be hunted here: {{MobSprite|Strongarm}}, {{MobSprite|Tepid}}, {{MobSprite|Polaris}}, {{MobSprite|Shuddersquid}}, {{MobSprite|Billygoat}}, {{MobSprite|Mantis Shrimp}}, {{MobSprite|Nozzlenose}}, {{MobSprite|Troodon}}, and {{MobSprite|Wumpa}}. {|class="wikitable" !Condition !Game Message |- |Reaching {{stat|Cold|-25}} |{{Rmt|&9&lBRRR! &r&bIt's getting really cold in here! All you can think about is getting out of here to a warm campfire...}} |- |Reaching {{stat|Cold|-100}} and dying, in the {{Blue|Icy}} biome of the {{Zone|Critter Safari}} |[[File:Death Icon.png|16px|link=]] {{Rmt|&7You fainted and lost some of your items!}} |- |} == Critters == {{Green|37}} [[Critters]] are native to the '''Critter Safari''', with {{Green|10}} Critters being found in the {{Purple|Haunted}} biome and {{Green|9}} Critters being found in the others. They can only be hunted with {{Item|Critter Capsule}}s, which are thrown at Critters. Regular [[Hunting Toolkit|Hunting Tools]], such as [[Huntaxes]], [[Black Holes]], [[Lassos]], and [[Fishing Nets]] are disabled in the '''Critter Safari''': if the player ever finds a way to have a Hunting Tool in their inventory, it will be automatically sent to the [[Stash]]. The higher the rarity of the [[Shard]] dropped by the player's desired Critter, the lower the chance to successfully capture the Critter. {|class="wikitable ct" ! Critter Rarity ! Successful Catch Chance ! Hard Pity{{Cite Discord|staff=y|url=https://discord.com/channels/651912910972649492/1529181650641228007/1535065175391207504|user=filmgoerdev|date=8/6/26, 7:28 PM (EST)|text=Hard Pity for Critter Capsules: - COMMON: 1 - UNCOMMON: 2 - RARE: 3 - EPIC: 5 - LEGENDARY: 20}} |- | {{Common}} | {{Chance|100%|1|1}} | 1 |- | {{Uncommon}} | {{Chance|75%|1|1.33}} | 2 |- | {{Rare}} | {{Chance|50%|1|2}} | 3 |- | {{Epic}} | {{Chance|25%|1|4}} | 5 |- | {{Legendary}} | {{Chance|5%|1|20}} | 20 |} If a critter is caught, every player in the '''Critter Safari''' receives the shard and progress towards [[Safari Milestones]], but not the [[Critterdex]]. Each Critter has a '''Uniqueness Score''', granting {{Skill XP|+5000 Hunting}} for each Critter caught, up to {{Skill XP|+185000 Hunting}} without Floor Drops or {{Stat|Hunting Wisdom}} being factored in. {{Stat|charm chance}} does not affect the '''Critter Safari'''. === Sparkling Critters === {{Sparkling}} [[Critters]] have a {{Green|1}}/{{Yellow|4,096}} chance to replace any Critter in the '''Critter Safari'''. {{Sparkling}} Critters are telegraphed with orange particles and a {{Rmt|&6&lSPARKLING}} tag in their name, alongside wind chimes playing when nearby. {{Sparkling}} Critters drop {{Green|10x}} of their regular drops, alongside a {{Item|Rainbow Feather}}, with a {{Green|25%}} chance of dropping another with the {{Attribute|Splendor}} attribute. Additionally, {{Sparkling}} Critters also have a {{Green|100x}} chance to drop an {{Item|Emerald Dye}}. {| class="wikitable" !Condition !Game Message |- |Capturing a {{Sparkling}} Critter |{{Dialogue| &6&l------------------------------------------- &6&lSPARKLING! &8 &ecaught a &6&lSPARKLING &8! &6&l------------------------------------------- &a&lCAPTURE! &7You caught a &6&lSPARKLING &8 &7and received a &5Rainbow Feather &7and #x &8! }} |- |[[Lootshare|Lootsharing]] a {{Sparkling}} Critter |{{Dialogue| &6&l------------------------------------------- &6&lSPARKLING! &8 &ecaught a &6&lSPARKLING &8! &6&l------------------------------------------- &6&lLOOT SHARE! &7You received a &5Rainbow Feather &7and #x &8 &7from &8 &7catching a &6&lSPARKLING &8! }} |} Catching {{Sparkling}} Critters contributes to the [[Sparkling Critterdex]], which is unlocked after completing the [[Critterdex]] and grants cosmetic rewards as an optional grind. The [[Sparkling Critterdex]] does '''not''' grant {{SBXP}}. Unlike the normal [[Critterdex]], captures will unlock the [[Sparkling Critterdex]] entry for all players in the lobby. The chances of spawning {{Sparkling}} Critters can be increased by {{Green|2x}} with a {{Item|Sparkling Amulet}}: the player will spawn with one equipped if they have the {{AN|Sparkling Specialist}} perk active, which can be purchased from {{NPCSprite|Archie}} for {{Item|Safari Essence|amount=10,000}}. The bonus of the {{Item|Sparkling Amulet}} does not stack. === List of Critters === {{:Critters/Critter Safari}} == Quest Items == '''Quest Items''' are {{Special}} items found around the '''Critter Safari''' that are used to interact with the environment, usually leading to exclusive [[Shard]]s that the player otherwise would not be able to access. === Floor Drops === {{Main|Floor Drops}} A limited number of '''Floor Drops''' will appear throughout the different biomes in the '''Critter Safari''': they do not respawn. '''Floor Drops''' may contain '''Quest Items''', {{Item|Safari Essence}}, {{Skl|Hunting|XP}}, or a [[Shard]]. For more information on each '''Quest Item''', view their respective articles. {| class="wikitable ct" ! {{Gold|Cavern}} !! {{DarkGreen|Forest}} !! {{Purple|Haunted}} !! {{Blue|Icy}} |- | colspan=4 | {{Item|Safari Essence|amount=1-8}} |- | colspan=4 | {{Skill XP|2500-10000 Hunting}} |- | {{Item|Flitter Shard|amount=1}} || {{Item|Foxtrot Shard|amount=1}} || {{Item|Litterbug Shard|amount=1}} || {{Item|Strongarm Shard|amount=1}} |- | {{Item|Shyworm Shard|amount=1}} || {{Item|Honeybug Shard|amount=1}} || {{Item|Solsnatcher Shard|amount=1}} || {{Item|Polaris Shard|amount=1}} |- | {{Item|Purple Gem|amount=1}} || {{Item|Yogi Berry|amount=1}} || {{Item|Soothing Incense|amount=1}} || {{Item|Icebreaker|amount=1}} |- | {{Item|Lime Gem|amount=1}} || {{Item|Wriggleworm|amount=1}} || {{Item|Shining Coin|amount=1}} || rowspan=2 | {{bc}} |- | {{Item|Orange Gem|amount=1}} || {{Item|Bag of Seeds|amount=1}} || {{bc}} |} === Harvestable Resources === Players can harvest {{Item|Wholesale Wheat}}, punch fish to get {{Item|Flavor-packed Fish}}, and break lily pads to get {{Item|Lush Lily Pad}}s. These resources can be found and used in the {{Orange|Cavern}} biome. === Birdfeeder === The Birdfeeder is found in the {{Dark Green|Forest}} Biome, and is used to spawn the three types of birds. {| class="wikitable" | rowspan="5" | [[File:Birdfeeder Render.png|120px]] ! rowspan="2" | Food Used ! rowspan="2" | Buffed Bird
({{Green|1.5x}} weight) ! colspan="3" | Birdfeeder Chances |- ! {{MobSprite|Bluebird}} Chance ! {{MobSprite|Parakeet}} Chance ! {{MobSprite|Macaw}} Chance |- | {{Item|Yogi Berry}} | {{MobSprite|Bluebird}} | {{Green|72%}} chance ({{Dark Gray|18 weight}}) | {{Green|24%}} chance ({{Dark Gray|6 weight}}) | {{Green|4%}} chance ({{Dark Gray|1 weight}}) |- | {{Item|Wriggleworm}} | {{MobSprite|Parakeet}} | {{Green|54.54%}} chance ({{Dark Gray|12 weight}}) | {{Green|40.91%}} chance ({{Dark Gray|9 weight}}) | {{Green|4.54%}} chance ({{Dark Gray|1 weight}}) |- | {{Item|Bag of Seeds}} | {{MobSprite|Macaw}} | {{Green|61.54%}} chance ({{Dark Gray|12 weight}}) | {{Green|30.77%}} chance ({{Dark Gray|6 weight}}) | {{Green|7.69%}} chance ({{Dark Gray|1.5 weight}}) |} == Safari Belt == {{Main|Safari Belt}} The {{Item|Safari Belt}} is the only item outside the '''Critter Safari''' the player may bring with them. It increments in rarity and stats depending on their '''Safari Milestones''', which can be viewed at {{NPCSprite|Andrea}}. * Successful hunts in the {{Gold|Cavern}} biome grant {{Stat|Hunting Wisdom}} and increases its rarity. * Successful hunts in the {{DarkGreen|Forest}} biome grant {{Stat|foraging fortune}}. * Successful hunts in the {{Purple|Haunted}} biome grant {{Stat|Hunting Fortune}}. * Successful hunts in the {{Blue|Icy}} biome grant {{Stat|cr}}. == Safari Essence == {{Main|Archie}} {{:Essence Shops/Safari}} The player can also salvage [[Shards]] from the '''Critter Safari''' for {{Item|Safari Essence}}. Conversion rates are as follows: * {{Common}} → {{Item|Safari Essence|amount=1}} * {{Uncommon}} → {{Item|Safari Essence|amount=2}} * {{Rare}} → {{Item|Safari Essence|amount=4}} * {{Epic}} → {{Item|Safari Essence|amount=8}} * {{Legendary}} → {{Item|Safari Essence|amount=16}} === Hunting Hotspot === If the player has the {{AN|Hunting Hotspot}} perk unlocked at {{NPCSprite|Archie}}, a random biome will be selected as the player's {{Pink|Hunting Hotspot}}. While in a {{Pink|Hunting Hotspot}}, the player gains {{Stat|hf|+5-25}}. == Bells == There are {{Green|7}} {{Item|Bell|link=}}s scattered around the '''Critter Safari''' at different locations. Upon finding all {{Green|7}} {{Item|Bell|link=}}s and returning to {{NPCSprite|"Hunter" Tobias}}, a cutscene begins to play. For the sake of spoilers, the following section will be hidden. {{Collapsible Section Button|id=bells|name=Show/Hide Bell Coordinates}} {{Collapsible Section|id=bells|mode=begin}} {{/Bells}} {{Collapsible Section|id=bells|mode=end}} == NPCs == {{Location NPCs}} == Fairy Souls == {{Fairy Souls}} == Tips == * Never enter the '''Critter Safari''' solo. Almost everything except for regular [[Critterdex]] progress and {{Item|Emerald Dye}}s is shared. Additionally, more players allow for a faster run. It is usually recommended to have at least 3 players, preferably 4. * In the [[Safari Essence Shop]], '''Morning Dew''' and '''Critter Master''' are one of the most important upgrades to obtain. ** The {{Item|Morning Dew}} grants the {{Item|Safari Belt}} {{Stat|Speed|50}} while in the '''Critter Safari''', allowing for faster clears, along a handful of stats that are useful within it. It is also currently the only [[Equipment]] [[Reforge]] that grants {{Skill|hunting}} stats. ** The {{Item|Masterful Critter Capsule}} has a {{Green|100%}} capture rate. It is best used on the {{MobSprite|Doomspiral}}, {{MobSprite|Wumpa}}, and, if it spawns, {{MobSprite|Macaw}}, which would allow up to 20 capsules to be saved. *** Players may also wish to use it on a {{Rarity|Rare}}, {{Rarity|Epic}} or {{Sparkling}} critter if they do not need to capture any of the above {{MobType|Critter|Critters}} (such as if they are clearing the {{Gold|'''Cavern'''}} biome) or are running low on capsules. * There are 2 types of '''Critter Safari''' runs: '''Full Clear''' and '''Unique''' runs. ** In a '''Full Clear''' run, players aim to capture all critters for shards. To effectively do this, it is a good strategy to let each player clear one biome. Hotspots could be used as a reference for allocations. *** Alternatively, two players could overlap the {{Gold|'''Cavern'''}} biome, one for the upper part and one for the lower, to achieve a faster run. This is because this biome takes the longest to clear by far. *** {{Item|Masterful Critter Capsule}}s are best to used on the {{MobSprite|Doomspiral}}, the {{MobSprite|Wumpa}}, and the two {{MobSprite|Macaw}}s if they spawn. ** In a '''Unique''' run, players trade off the amount of shards obtained for the speed of capturing all unique critters. Such runs are the quickest way for grinding {{Skill|hunting}} experience by far. *** For mobs that are difficult to catch, such as {{MobSprite|Treefrog}}s, their duplicate captures are usually discarded for efficiency. *** The common strategy is to allocate each player to a biome. As the amount of shards is no longer the goal, Hotspots are usually ignored. There would be no need to overlap the {{Gold|'''Cavern'''}} biome. *** Players may wish to use a {{Item|Masterful Critter Capsule}} on a {{MobSprite|Gemzie}}. * {{Sparkling}} critters that do not use vanilla textures (such as {{MobSprite|Shyworm}}) have custom textures when they spawn that differ from their normal texture. This can be used to determine if critters such as {{MobSprite|Troodon}} and {{MobSprite|Hideyho}} are {{Sparkling}} before interacting with them, as they do not have name tags before being interacted with. * Usually it is better to spend a bit of downtime between runs to get {{Rarity|Uncommon}} on [[Miria's Contest]] whenever there is a new contest to secure more safari tickets for more runs. * Always use a {{Orange|'''First-Class'''}} ticket unless you are hunting only for {{Sparkling}} critters. The additional {{Item|Safari Essence}} will most likely outweigh the cost in upgrading tickets, and the additional {{Stat|hunting wisdom}} is also nice to have. == Notes == *[[Bestiary]] progress, {{Item|Safari Belt}} Milestones progress, [[Attribute Shard]] drops and [[Sparkling Critterdex]] entries are shared with everyone in a party — effectively everything except loot obtained from [[Floor Drops]], trading with NPCs and unlocking entries for the regular [[Critterdex]]. ** While Attribute Shard drops are shared, every player's {{stat|Hunting Fortune}} is counted for them individually. *The {{Skl|Hunting|XP}} gain from '''Critter Safari''' is affected by {{stat|Hunting Wisdom}} that the player has inside Safari. It is also affected by {{NPCSprite|Derpy}}'s {{Pink|MOAR SKILLZ!!!}} perk. *Unlike with the [[Catacombs]], players who leave the '''Critter Safari''' cannot reenter. == Trivia == * The release of the '''Critter Safari''' marks the first time since [[SkyBlock]]'s release where more than one island has been released in one update. * Excluding {{MobSprite|Gimmiegold}}s, there are on average {{Green|40}} critters in the {{Orange|Cavern}} biome, {{Green|33.91}} critters in the {{Dark Green|Forest}} biome, {{Green|33}} critters in the {{Purple|Haunted}} biome and {{Green|35}} critters in the {{Blue|Icy}} biome, for a total of {{Green|141.91}} critters. ** The chance of getting at least one {{Sparkling}} critter is then approximately {{Green|3.4%}}, raised to {{Green|6.6%}} with a {{Item|Sparkling Amulet}}. * A '''Critter Safari''' instance will automatically close after around {{Green|60}} minutes regardless of progress or player activity. == Gallery == Floating Iceberg Render.png|An iceberg found in the Icy Biome Frozen Bell Render.png|The frozen bell found in the Icy Biome Flipped Frozen Bell Render.png|The frozen bell after being flipped Flipped Bell Render.png|The frozen bell found after being freed Critter Safari Rainbow Render.png|The rainbow that spawns after ringing all bells == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2026/June 10|Added '''Safari Zone'''.}} {{History|2026/July 22|version=none|Added {{Skill|Hunting|XV}} requirement to access.}} {{History|2026/July 29|Renamed to '''Critter Safari'''.}} |beta = {{History|2026/July 3|link=none|Teased the existence of the '''Critter Safari'''.}} {{History|0.27|Added '''Critter Safari'''.}} {{History|2026/August 11|Adjusted {{Item|Yogi Berry}}, {{Item|Wriggleworm}} and {{Item|Bag of Seeds}} to be only from the {{Dark Green|Forest}} Biome's Floor Drops.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Locations}} == References == {{Reflist}}
